description: Source code for the CHistoryCollector class, managing calculation history, command parsing, and expression display in a calculator application.

classes.name: CHistoryCollector
classes.description: Manages calculation history, command parsing, and expression display for calculator operations.

methods.name: ReinitHistory
methods.description: Reinitializes the history state variables and clears token and command lists.

methods.name: AddOpndToHistory
methods.description: Adds an operand to the calculation history with associated rational value.

methods.name: RemoveLastOpndFromHistory
methods.description: Removes the last operand from the history.

methods.name: AddBinOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a binary operator to the history with specified opcode and mode.

methods.name: ChangeLastBinOp
methods.description: Updates the last binary operator, possibly adding brackets for precedence inversion.

methods.name: PushLastOpndStart
methods.description: Pushes the start index of the last operand onto the operand index stack.

methods.name: PopLastOpndStart
methods.description: Pops the last operand start index from the stack.

methods.name: AddOpenBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds an open parenthesis to the history.

methods.name: AddCloseBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds a close parenthesis to the history.

methods.name: EnclosePrecInversionBrackets
methods.description: Encloses the previous operand in brackets to invert precedence.

methods.name: FOpndAddedToHistory
methods.description: Checks if an operand has been added to the history.

methods.name: AddUnaryOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a unary operator to the history, wrapping the last operand.

methods.name: CompleteHistoryLine
methods.description: Finalizes a history line after calculation, updating display.

methods.name: CompleteEquation
methods.description: Completes the current equation, adding '=' token and updating display.

methods.name: ClearHistoryLine
methods.description: Clears the current history line, optionally on error.

methods.name: IchAddSzToEquationSz
methods.description: Adds a string to the current equation tokens and returns its index.

methods.name: InsertSzInEquationSz
methods.description: Inserts a string into the equation tokens at a specified position.

methods.name: TruncateEquationSzFromIch
methods.description: Removes tokens from a specified index onward.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with current tokens and commands.

methods.name: AddCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to the command list.

methods.name: UpdateHistoryExpression
methods.description: Updates operand commands based on current radix and precision.

methods.name: SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Sets the decimal symbol used in number parsing.

methods.name: GetOperandCommandsFromString
methods.description: Generates operand commands from a string representation of a number.

methods.name: GetOperandCommandsFromString
methods.description: Creates an operand command object from a string and rational value.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of current expression commands.
